Four fullU80 square pair sums now register before the remaining two levels; statistics5 cycles and local compositions add one cycle per eight elements. Same numerical domain and ports; cycles must be freshly measured. Six16CPU slots immediate refill, mapping64GiB others16GiB with1.2 forecast plus16GiB guard/liveRSS. No repeated M/S/T, no EDA cancellation; fresh measurements and every physical/final gate required.
